title: C24/25/2017 of Priti Maheshwari Vs Tarun Goel

paras.text:
C24 No. 25 of 2017
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
None turns up on behalf of the
petitioner even in the revised call.
Steps were not taken as directed
by the court earlier.
So, this petition is hereby
dismissed in non-prosecution.
Stay order (if any) stands vacated.
